raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` silently drops late-arriving transactions. In each batch from 3 onward, about 20% of rows have txn_ts roughly 3 days before ingest_ts, and those rows are lost. txn_id is unique across all raw rows, so these are genuine transactions with no duplicates, and nothing documents a rule to discard late data. Removing the lag filter and keeping only the POSTED filter restores them.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
